en: The postcard features an illustrated scene showing several men in Ottoman military uniforms, one on horseback, with the skyline of old Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) in the background. Prominently visible are domes and minarets characteristic of the city's famous mosques and historical structures. There is handwritten French text on much of the card, and a printed caption 'SOUVENIR DE CONSTANTINOPLE.'
